stories.stat_label: Viking Age coins found so far
stories.headline: A Viking hoard grew from 19 coins to a record 5,500
stories.summary: Metal detectorists found 19 silver coins at Mørstad in April. Digs have since raised it to 5,500, including a coin of King Olaf II, struck 1024–1028. Fewer than 20 are known.
stories.why: It's the biggest such hoard found in Norway since 1866, and the coin may have been in the king's own hand.

stories.headline: A desert snake last recorded in 1872 was seen again
stories.summary: Forest officers on patrol near Bhuj photographed an Afro-Asian sand snake, the first confirmed record in Kutch since a naturalist described it there in 1872.
stories.why: It was likely there all along, unseen: a reminder of how much quiet wildlife dry lands hide.

stories.headline: A drug-free PTSD treatment was cleared by the FDA
stories.summary: It maps each patient's brain waves, then targets magnetic pulses to match. The maker reports a 52% drop in symptoms and 68% remission in its trial; full results are still to come.
stories.why: Until now, the only FDA-approved PTSD treatments were 2 medications.

stories.stat_label: miles walked to bring her home
stories.headline: No trap could catch a stray dog, so a man walked her 90 miles
stories.summary: For a month, volunteers tried to rescue a wary dog living at a remote rest area. Then a hiker set off on foot with his own dog, and she followed them for 4 days, all the way to safety.
stories.why: He renamed her Juniper, after the trees that sheltered her, and asked to stay anonymous.
